subject: How to visualize tree with associated matrix using scaled dot sizes

messages.author: 2e965abcb7328238
messages.subject: How to visualize tree with associated matrix using scaled dot sizes
parts:
Hi there,

I'm trying to plot a tree figure similar to Figure 1 of Weiner & Kooij 2016 (https://doi.org/10.15698/mic2016.10.534) available at http://microbialcell.com/figure-1-phylogenetic-profiles-of-plasmodium-transporters/ using ggtree.

I think, I could use the phyloseq package somewhat like so to obtain something similar:

library("phyloseq")
data("esophagus")
plot_tree(esophagus, size="abundance", justify = "left")

Yet, I have a tree with a simple associated matrix only and would preferably use ggtree but I'm currently not sure how to best approach this using ggtree?

Many thanks in advance for any help!

Jan
